inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "A piece of a pixel art battle stage background at its own pixel size: a warm afternoon sky over jagged red mountains, a camp of patched tents on a terrace, black obelisks and pillars with ram skulls in front. In it: three sun moths in the sky and seven pilgrims of foreign tribes on the terrace, small, in the same pixel art, colours and light as everything around them. Rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background.
